description: This Java class `PinShortcutConfirm` is an Android activity that handles the confirmation process for pinning a shortcut. It displays shortcut details and allows the user to accept or cancel the pinning request.

classes.name: PinShortcutConfirm
classes.description: An Android activity for confirming the pinning of a shortcut, showing shortcut details and handling user acceptance or cancellation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, retrieves the shortcut request, and displays shortcut info including icon, label, and ID.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for OK and Cancel buttons, either accepting the shortcut or cancelling the operation.

methods.name: acceptShortcut
methods.description: Accepts the shortcut pinning request and logs the result.
